summary: PagerDuty, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a new $100 million share repurchase program authorized by its Board, replacing earlier programs. The program allows repurchases via open market, private transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 plans, with no obligation to buy a specified number; it will be funded from existing cash and run through May 26, 2028, unless extended or terminated. PagerDuty is the issuer. Watch for execution pace and any market reaction; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a discretionary buyback, not a fixed-price tender.
